text: ぜんぶ　おれに　まかせれば　いーんだって！

structure.jp: ぜんぶ　おれに　まかせれば
structure.en: if you leave it all to me

patterns.name: 〜ばいい
patterns.explanation: A verb ending in ば plus いい means 'all you need to do is this'; いー is a drawn-out いい. まかせれば いー = 'you should just leave it to me'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ adds the feel of pressing a point; んだ is its shortened spoken form. いーんだ = 'it's fine, see'.

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: って is casual と for repeating words; at the end of your own sentence it sounds like insisting. いーんだって = 'I'm telling you, it's fine!'
